import os
import tempfile
import pytest

# Import the public API from the Doorstop package
from doorstop.core.item import Item
from doorstop.core.document import Document
from doorstop.core.exporter import export_file
from doorstop.core.importer import import_file
from doorstop.core.publisher import publish
from doorstop.core.tree import Tree


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper functions
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
def _create_temp_file(content: str, suffix: str = ".txt") -> str:
    """Create a temporary file with the given content and return its path."""
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix=suffix)
    with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(content)
    return path


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Test cases
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
def test_U01_2__Gherkin_BDD___TC_001():
    """
    Test: Unique and permanent identifiers
    Expected: Receive a unique and permanent identifier
    """
    # Create a linkable section of text
    text = "This is a requirement."
    item = Item.new(name="REQ-001", text=text)

    # The UID should be a non-empty string
    assert isinstance(item.uid, str) and item.uid, "UID is not a non-empty string"

    # The UID should be unique across multiple items
    item2 = Item.new(name="REQ-002", text="Another requirement.")
    assert item.uid != item2.uid, "UIDs are not unique"


def test_U01_2__Gherkin_BDD___TC_002():
    """
    Test: Formatting support
    Expected: Support formatting within the linkable text
    """
    # Create a requirement with Markdown formatting
    text = "This is a **bold** requirement."
    item = Item.new(name="REQ-003", text=text)

    # The text should preserve the formatting markers
    assert "**bold**" in item.text, "Formatting markers not preserved in text"

def test_U01_2__Gherkin_BDD___TC_005():
    """
    Test: Export to common text/document tools
    Expected: Be able to interact with the exported content
    """
    # Create a simple document with one item
    doc = Document.new(name="Doc1", text="Document header")
    doc.add_item(Item.new(name="REQ-004", text="Exportable requirement."))

    # Export the document to a temporary YAML file
    tmp_path = _create_temp_file("", suffix=".yml")
    export_file(doc, tmp_path)

    # Verify that the file exists and contains the UID of the item
    assert os.path.exists(tmp_path), "Export file was not created"
    with open(tmp_path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
        content = f.read()
    assert doc.items[0].uid in content, "Exported content does not contain the item UID"
